name: Skybell City
description: This blessed city hosts the holiest Celestianist Cathedral, a pilgrimage site steeped in legend. It’s said that angels gathered here to fight the Ungods ages ago. The Cathedral conceals ancient artifacts, scriptures, and the tombs of holy figures. Rumors suggest it even holds angelic relics. Though under Imperial jurisdiction, the Cathedral grounds follow Celestianist law and are protected by its paladins, a legacy of an ancient pact with Emperor Baleroth. The city’s central market thrives due to pilgrims across Tanares offering many goods. However, non-Celestianist followers are not welcome; no other temples exist, and while the practice of other religions is not illegal, it is clear that such worship is seen as an affront to the local populace. The Cult of Shadow Wing aims to corrupt Skybell. They almost succeeded before the Celestianist Reform and now regroup in hidden corners. Their agenda includes corrupting clergy, undermining people’s faith, and fostering counter-reform to revert the Church to its original Evolutionist dogma. By creating false hints of corruption against the Church leaders, they seek to manipulate public opinion. Though the Church has countered its efforts, Skybell remains the focal point of the Cult’s activities.
